title: Exact Shapley Values
learning_objectives: Define a coalition value function with a baseline
Compute exact Shapley values by enumerating subsets
Verify efficiency, symmetry and dummy properties
entry_point: coalition_value(predict, x, baseline, subset); shapley_values(predict, x, baseline)
hints: Loop j; for size in 0..d−1 and each `S` in `combinations(others, size)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Use weights |S|!(d−|S|−1)!/d! and include the empty coalition.
Average marginal contributions over all coalitions of the other features.
Take x on coalition indices and the baseline elsewhere; call predict on shape (1, d).
For linear models Shapley values equal w·(x − baseline).
